name: JeffCom 911
description: Ingests computer-aided dispatch (CAD) incidents and unit locations from JeffCom 911 via schedule and webhook and posts them to the map.

permissions.description: JeffCom 911 posts CAD incidents and unit locations to the map

schedule.description: Polls JeffCom 911 for updated CAD incidents on a schedule.

webhook.description: Receives JeffCom 911 CAD updates pushed to the webhook endpoint.
